title: Joining John Williams's combo and how she felt about him
summary: She joined John's six-piece combo in the Harris show to get away from home. She admired him as a person but did not love him enough to marry, and the group toured small towns in Indiana, Ohio and Oklahoma.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Well, we left you where you had just met John Williams. Did he join the Buzzin Harris show by himself...?
With a combo, about 6 of us including myself.
I don't remember if I just played piano and that's all for the show. I don't remember having a drummer or anybody then.
So you were the whole thing?
I may have been. I don't remember drums or bass or tuba. See they used tubas then.
When John Williams brought his group in and you became a part of it, what was your early reaction to John? Did you like him or not like him, or what?

Not enough to (ask him) but I did it to get away from home. I admired him because he was such a giant in bringing love among musicians and bringing them together. He was such a giant in picking out problems right away and I admired him for his ability, but as far as marrying I don't think I loved him enough.
This time how long did the whole show stay together?
For a long time. We just went right to the end there, till there was nothing else more to do. They stuck together for a long time.
How wide an area did you tour?
Let's see, Indiana, Ohio - we never did hit the major cities. We were in Oklahoma, small places. It was impossible to really make a living...
